summary: This Phase 3 study tests study drugs called eloralintide and tirzepatide in adults who have obesity or are overweight, along with type 2 diabetes. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring this trial to see how the treatments affect body weight over about two years. A total of 1000 participants are expected to take part in the recruiting study. The trial compares the combination treatment of eloralintide and tirzepatide against tirzepatide alone.
